Thanks for the update, Diego — glad it was nothing worse. No worries on missing the slot.

I took a quick look at the debug attachment you sent (thank you). A couple of observations:
- 401 immediately after token exchange often indicates header trimming by a proxy. Can your infra team confirm that Authorization headers are allowed through the proxy?
- Also check that the API key you're using is the trial key (starts with trial_); if you rotated a key in the portal the SDK may still be picking up an old env var.

Proposed next steps:
1) If your network team is available, can they join a 30-minute troubleshooting window so we can watch a live request?
2) If not, please run the one-line curl below from a machine on your network and paste the output:
   curl -s -D - -H "Authorization: Bearer <TRIAL_KEY>" "https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","prompt":"hello"}'

I’m attaching a slightly expanded checklist and a tiny helper script that prints the env + sample request (sdk-init.sh). That script is safe to run — it does not send keys anywhere but echoes what the SDK would send.

Can you confirm availability for either: Tue 2027-04-06 10:30 PT or Wed 2027-04-07 11:00 PT? If those don’t work, drop three alternative times and we’ll lock one in.

Thanks,
Monica
Lead Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sdk-init.sh (attachment), trial-preflight-checklist.pdf

Diego —

Thanks for the earlier notes. Monica is tied up this morning but asked me to step in to get you unblocked.

If your proxy is dropping Authorization headers, a quick workaround for a short trial is to terminate the TLS at an app tier that preserves headers (or to rebuild requests through a sidecar that forwards headers). Not ideal long-term, but it helps confirm the root cause.

I booked a 20-minute recovery slot and sent a Calendly invite — here’s the public link if you need to pick a different time: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min?month=2027-04

Before the slot: please run the sdk-init.sh on a machine that sits behind the proxy and paste the output (the script will echo the Authorization header length without exposing the key). If that reports an empty header, it confirms trimming at the proxy and we’ll bring network-level mitigations into the call.

Proposed slot (locked): Tue 2027-04-06 10:30 PT — sent invite to your calendar. If you prefer the Wed slot Monica suggested, accept from Calendly.

Thanks — we’ll get you past the handshake quickly.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
